title: Singlife One Clark International Marathon 2026 Review: RUNRIO's Flagship Freeport Race
seo_title: Singlife One Clark Marathon 2026 Review | Clark Philippines
meta_description: The Singlife One Clark International Marathon 2026: September 20 at Clark Parade Grounds. 42K, 21K, 10K, 5K from RUNRIO with registration open.
dek: Set for 20 September 2026 at Clark Parade Grounds, this RUNRIO-produced marathon is backed by Singlife insurance. Four distances with registration open. One of the Philippines' premier freeport marathons.
verdict: The Singlife One Clark International Marathon combines RUNRIO's gold-standard production with Clark Freeport's wide, traffic-free roads — one of the Philippines' best marathon venues. Four distances (42K, 21K, 10K, 5K) with registration open. Singlife's insurance-brand backing adds commercial credibility and quality race merchandise. Clark's flat boulevards make this a genuine PB opportunity. September in Pampanga is the tail of the wet season — warm but manageable with an early start. For runners wanting a RUNRIO-produced, PB-friendly marathon in a world-class running environment, this is a top-tier Philippine pick.

sections.heading: Clark: The PB Factory
paragraphs: Clark Freeport's wide boulevards — legacy of the former US airbase — provide one of the Philippines' flattest, fastest marathon surfaces with minimal traffic. [1] The Clark Parade Grounds is a central, open venue with space for a full race village. Singlife's sponsorship brings commercial production values to RUNRIO's proven race-day template.
